v4.6.66 — Adjustable AI call delay (with live cost preview)

⏱️ CONTROL HOW OFTEN EACH BOT CALLS THE AI
• Every bot tab now has an 'AI call delay (sec)' control. Set how many seconds the bot waits between cycles, see the projected cost update live (calls/day, $/day, $/month), and confirm before it applies.
• Takes effect on the bot's next cycle — no restart needed — and syncs to your 24/7 cloud bots too.
• Safety: 30s is the hard minimum, and anything under ~60s is flagged (calling too often can hit API rate limits, spike cost, and overlap cycles).

Update via the in-app banner.
